page.title: Receipt templates
page.description: Define the format printed or shared for sales, quotations, and electronic documents. The default template for each type is used automatically.

emptyState.title: No templates yet
emptyState.description: Create your first template to define how receipts will be printed.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard your changes?
unsavedChanges.message: The changes to this receipt have not been saved. If you leave now, you will lose them.

guidedSetup.createDescription: Choose the document and paper. You can save the default format as it is or review each section when you need to customize it.
guidedSetup.editDescription: Update the name or paper and review the preview. The document type stays fixed so its usage does not change.

structureSummary.presetTitle: The receipt is ready to use
structureSummary.presetDescription_one: The format includes {{count}} prepared section. Review the preview and customize its structure only when needed.
structureSummary.presetDescription_other: The format includes {{count}} prepared sections. Review the preview and customize its structure only when needed.
structureSummary.existingDescription_one: This template has {{count}} configured section. You can adjust its content and order.
structureSummary.existingDescription_other: This template has {{count}} configured sections. You can adjust its content and order.

blocksPanel.title: Receipt sections
blocksPanel.description: Add, edit, or reorder the sections that print. Use the grip or arrow buttons to change their order.
blocksPanel.empty: Add a section to get started.

dragAndDrop.screenReaderInstructions: To pick up a section, press space or enter. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move it. Press space or enter again to drop, or escape to cancel.

previewPanel.title: Live preview
previewPanel.templateIssues: Fix the highlighted template expressions before the preview can render.

blockFields.columnsHelp: Pick the columns to print, in order.
blockFields.itemsTableCaption: Shows the products in the current sale. Use the columns below to choose which information gets printed.
blockFields.totalsBlockCaption: Where do these values come from?

totalsBlockBindings.subtotal: Subtotal — sum of item totals before taxes.
totalsBlockBindings.discount: Discount — total discounts applied to items.
totalsBlockBindings.taxTotal: Tax — sum of tax amounts across all items.
totalsBlockBindings.tip: Tip — optional gratuity field on the sale.
totalsBlockBindings.serviceCharge: Service — charge applied automatically using the rate configured for the business.
totalsBlockBindings.grandTotal: Total — subtotal minus discounts plus taxes, tip, and service.

blockFields.appFooterHelp: Adds three lines at the bottom of the receipt with the Puntovivo product name, URL, and support contact. Keep it enabled to credit the software, or toggle it off for a branding-free receipt.
blockFields.wordmarkHelp: Prints the Puntovivo brand mark at the top of the receipt. The mark cannot be changed, keeping the presentation consistent.
blockFields.metaTableHelp: Organizes the receipt's main details in two columns (document, date, cashier, and more). Each value accepts the same fields and functions as a text section.

codeEditor.placeholder: Use double curly braces to open the picker for variables and functions.

linter.unparseable: This expression cannot be read. Use a field such as sale.grandTotal or a function such as currency(...).
linter.unknownNamespace: Unknown data group "{{namespace}}". You can use: {{allowed}}.

codeEditor.unavailableVariable: {{path}} is not configured for this business. The receipt will print this value as empty until the corresponding setting is populated.

functionsHelp.title: Available functions
functionsHelp.intro: Write fields inside double curly braces to replace them with receipt data. You can also use the functions below with fields such as sale.grandTotal, numbers, or quoted text.

entries.currency: Format a number with the business currency settings. Optional second argument overrides decimals.
entries.date: Format a date or ISO string. Pattern tokens: yyyy MM dd HH mm ss. Defaults to the business short date format.
entries.round: Round a number to N decimals (default 0).
entries.limit: Truncate text to N characters and append an ellipsis when shortened.
entries.concat: Join multiple values into a single string.
entries.default: Return the fallback when the first argument is empty (null, undefined, or whitespace only).

delete.title: Delete template
delete.confirmMessage: This template will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

errors.atLeastOneBlock: Add at least one section to the template.
